shadowpriest:Voidform.NAME: Voidform
shadowpriest:Voidform.FLAVOR: Wait for the moment. Then let everything go.
DESCRIPTIONS: Each direct Attack hit gains #b10 #yInsanity, even if blocked. Each DoT tick, including triggered ticks, gains #b1 #yInsanity. NL Whenever you lose HP from damage in combat, gain #b5 #yInsanity. At #b100, gain a #b0-cost retained card to enter #yVoidform. NL In Voidform, Attacks cost #b1 less and deal #b50% more damage this turn. X costs are unchanged. NL Insanity persists between turns. One charge at a time; no gain while ready or active. Resets when Voidform ends or combat ends. NL Enter #yRecharge when Voidform ends: you cannot gain Insanity through the end of your next turn.

shadowpriest:ShadowyPreparation.NAME: Shadowy Preparation
shadowpriest:ShadowyPreparation.FLAVOR: The battle begins before the first whisper.
DESCRIPTIONS: At combat start, gain #b10 #yInsanity for each enemy.

shadowpriest:IdolOfCthun.NAME: Idol of C'Thun
DESCRIPTIONS: At combat start, add a #yTentacle #ySlam to your hand. It costs #b0 for the entire combat.

shadowpriest:IdolOfYshaarj.NAME: Idol of Y'Shaarj
DESCRIPTIONS: During #yVoidform, whenever you play a card that spends Energy, draw #b1 card after its effects.

shadowpriest:IdolOfNzoth.NAME: Idol of N'Zoth
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you play a Power or equip your Legendary at combat start, gain #b1 #yMastery.

shadowpriest:ImprovedVoidform.NAME: Improved Voidform
shadowpriest:ImprovedVoidform.FLAVOR: The void is not finished with you.
DESCRIPTIONS: Voidform persists across turns until you have played #b3 Attack cards during that activation, then ends at the end of that turn. NL Surrender remains permanent.

shadowpriest:VoidVengeance.NAME: Void Vengeance
DESCRIPTIONS: Each turn, you may play one Curse for #b0 Energy. It #yExhausts. NL Whenever you #yExhaust a Curse, gain #b2 #yHaste.
